product.name: Monoprice Cat6A Ethernet Patch Cable - 90 Degree Connector Double Shielded (S/FTP) 36AWG 10G CM Pure Bare Copper Snagless RJ45 SlimRun 0.5ft Blue
product.description: Monoprice™ SlimRun™ Cat6A F/FTP Ethernet Network Patch Cables are designed for high performance 10G environments. SlimRun Cat6A F/FTP is much thinner and lighter than standard Cat6A shielded cables. The 0.1578‑inch diameter, 36AWG flexible cable, and light TPE jacket is easier to install/uninstall and takes less space than conventional 23 or 24 AWG Cat6A shielded cables. The 90‑degree connector is great when tight spaces exist and space is a premium.Monoprice™ Ethernet cables are made of 100% pure bare copper wire, as opposed to copper clad aluminum (CCA) wire, and are therefore fully compliant with UL® Code 444 and National Electrical Code® TIA‑568‑C.2 fire and safety standards, which require pure bare copper wire in communications cables. High PerformanceF/FTP ShieldingUltra‑thin with 90° ConnectorHigh Performance: This cable is designed for use in 10‑Gigabit Ethernet environments and is backwards compatible with existing Fast Ethernet and Gigabit Ethernet networks.F/FTP Shielding: The shielded connectors with gold‑plated contacts and molded strain‑relief boots are very durable and resist corrosion.Ultra‑thin with 90° Connector: The 36AWG conductors and ultra‑thin TPE jacket makes this one of the lightest cable options available. The 90‑degree connector saves time, space, and frustration in crowded areas and tight spaces. Reduces Congestion in High Density SpacesDesigned for high density environments where space is a premium, SlimRun's ultra‑slim 36AWG cable and narrow boot design reduces congestion and simplifies moves, additions, and changes.
